gloss: first calligraphy of the new year

definitions.gloss: first calligraphy of the new year
definitions.explanation: The practice of writing calligraphy for the first time in the new year, traditionally done on January 2nd. A longstanding Japanese New Year custom, often performed with a brush and ink.

examples.japanese: {書|か}き{初|ぞ}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{書|か}き{初|ぞ}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The children did their first calligraphy of the year at school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書|か}き{初|ぞ}め⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧」⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: For this year's first calligraphy, I wrote the characters for 'hope.'

notes:
A traditional New Year custom, typically done on January 2nd ({一月二日|いちがつふつか}). People write auspicious words or phrases with brush and ink. Schools often assign {書|か}き{初|ぞ}め as a winter holiday task, and contests ({書|か}き{初|ぞ}め⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧) are held in January.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {書|か}き{初|ぞ}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do first calligraphy
- {書|か}き{初|ぞ}め⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧: calligraphy contest (New Year)
- {書|か}き{初|ぞ}め⟦{展|てん}→〜展：28468_ten⟧: calligraphy exhibition

CULTURAL NOTE:
The tradition dates back centuries. Writing on January 2nd ({仕事始|しごとはじ}め, the customary first work day) is considered to bring skill improvement throughout the year. Common words chosen include ⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧ (hope), ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧ (effort), ⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧ (peace), and ⟦{新春|しんしゅん}→新春：13045_shinshun⟧ (new spring).
